issue.title: notification-gates.md is 6,158 words, over the 6,000-word reference cap, so docs-lint fails on master
issue.description:
All three sase-1uu phase beads proposed this follow-up (sase-1uu.1 note #2, sase-1uu.2 note #3, sase-1uu.3 note #1). `just docs-lint` (the `lint (docs contract)` stage of `just check` / `just lint`) fails on master 333f244b50:

```
error: reference/automation/notification-gates.md: over budget at 6158 words (cap 6000 for reference/). This page may not grow. Split it: anything longer than one goal is two guides.
check_docs: 1 error(s)
```

History: the page was already 6,009 words before 07411341e3 / da2165b80f (sase-1ut gate-turn epic) grew it to 6,158. Epic sase-1uu never touched it.

Fix: read the docs_writing memory note first, then split the page by goal, for example moving the accepted-but-failed execution / recovery material or another self-contained section into its own reference page with nav and links updated, or trim it so it ends under 6,000 words. Related: sase-1sr tracks a separate schema correction on the same page, so coordinate edits to avoid collisions.

Repro: `.venv/bin/python tools/check_docs` from the repo root.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The word count is static. tools/check_docs reports 6,158 words against the 6,000 reference/ cap on 333f244b50, and the page is unchanged since da2165b80f.

issue.creation_reason: The docs word-budget gate fails on every clean master tree, so every agent's just check reports it. All three sase-1uu phases recorded it as a proposed follow-up, and no task tracked it.
